text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Explosion in eastern Nigerian city of Port Harcourt kills one.
- Repairs of Nigeria's four oil refineries will soon begin.
- Executive director of Life Breweries in Onitsha, eastern Nigeria, says 200 million naira is needed to revive the company and put it on the path to growth.
- Filling stations within 25 km (16 miles) of the border between Nigeria and Benin have been closed as part of efforts to check smuggling of fuel.

- Nigerian Shareholders Solidarity Association calls on the oil ministry to stop holding shareholders to ransom over the creation of new boards of directors for Unipetrol and African Petroleum. The government, which has a 40 percent stake in each company, scrapped the boards last year.
- World Bank approves $3 million loan to finance five projects being carried out by four private companies in Nigeria.
